Late last night, credit to the gate agent
The new month is here
Smooth paws, calm plans

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is stepping into the month with the same steady care travelers count on. From quick check-ins to comfort notes, the team keeps an eye on every detail that helps pets feel settled and keeps owners informed. Every trip starts with a shared sense of responsibility, and that means matching each companion with the right care, the right pace, and a little extra patience.

This week, the desk is also seeing a welcome mix of familiar routines and fresh requests, which keeps the work lively and rewarding. Whether it is a nervous cat, a relaxed dog, or a pet with special comfort needs, Aurelia Skyways is ready to help make the journey smoother from skyport to skyport. Small details matter, and they make a big difference for everyone involved.
